newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy 76,000/T Apr 1-15 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy 76,000/T Apr 1-15 fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy two 38,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5 percent sulphur fuel oil for April 1-15 delivery, industry sources said on Thursday.
CPC seeks one high pour cargo for delivery to Kaoshiung and one low pour cargo for delivery to Keelung or Taichung.
The tender closes on February 26 and is valid until February 28.

CPC bought a total of five 38,000-tonne cargoes for arrival in March in two tenders at $135-138 per tonne for two cargoes in the first tender and at $142.50 for three cargoes in the second tender, both on a cost-and-freight basis to Taiwan.
"Three to four cargoes per month is normal ... one cargo additional does not make a big difference," a CPC official said.
Traders said it was normal for CPC to buy such large volumes at this time of the year as the company usually buys during this period to replenish stocks after the peak winter demand.
